title: Spellbooks 'n Stuff SMP
description: A serving using the Spellbooks 'n Stuff modpack primarily based on Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks, however there is plenty more mods than just that
body: Minecraft server using a edited version of the Spellbooks 'n Stuff Modpack (created by me), the server has plenty of content, mainly surrounding the irons spells n spellbook mod and addons for the mod, but there is plenty of other mods that add content that are on the server
